title: The back rank
brief: Black's king has never made an escape square. One move ends it.
hint: The pawns in front of the king are the wall he cannot get through.

title: Smothered
brief: Every square around the black king is taken by his own men. Use it.
hint: Only one piece can reach a king with no flight squares.

title: Two at once
brief: The black king and the rook on a8 have something in common.
hint: A knight does not care what stands between its two targets.

title: One pawn, one idea
brief: King and pawn against king. Every move is the only move.
hint: Push the king before the pawn. The pawn is the last thing to move, not the first.

title: Réti's square
brief: Your king is nowhere near either pawn and the position is lost. It is not.
hint: A king moving diagonally does two jobs at once. Chase the pawn and shepherd your own.
